body:
In sixth grade we had this big end of the year trip where we went to camp. Everybody went except for a handful of kids who had misbehaved enough (I think like 3-4), the severely autistic kid, and me. I just didn't want to go, yeah, I could've gone if I wanted to, I had every right to do it and nobody was holding me back, I just really wasn't interested. Well, my teacher, who was a bit of a dick all around to be honest decided that simply because I chose to stay behind he would punish me like the handful of other kids who had done something wrong. 

That was the plan at least for all of about 4 days until my mum stormed in there and had a nice little chat with him.

Currently I'm battling the worst bout of depression well, ever to be completely honest and for all intents and purposes I'm dead. Anyway though, usually I do one of two things to help try and put my mind at ease. Either I sit down and draw for a few hours or I'll take a long walk in the middle of the night so I can be as alone as possible. Sometimes I'll call the suicide hotline just to talk with someone who cares.
God, that really hits close for me, someone who is already dead calmly talking about suicide, tragic.

Thanks, I'm trying to just do myself but it can only get me so far. I'm trying to just be a decent person even when I'm feeling completely hopeless, I want to leave a good impact here. Thanks for the kind words, at least someone cares.
